answer: A bond is refunded only after 17 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The ember counter is kept in meadow and ripple reveals each reset. Anyone thus has to keep each alias continuously active for 17 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 558 identities would post 534 proofs and burn roughly 49 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
